title.en: Trump renaming fiasco fuels jokes as Maher takes Kennedy Center’s Mark Twain prize
title.zh: 特朗普改名闹剧引爆笑料，马赫获肯尼迪中心马克·吐温奖

summary.en: A Washington D.C. gala for the Mark Twain Prize became a platform for jokes about a former president's failed attempt to have a building named after him, with a tarpaulin still covering the intended new name outside the venue, concealing his humiliation.
summary.zh: 在华盛顿特区举行的马克·吐温奖颁奖晚会上，人们纷纷拿一名前总统未能成功将一座建筑以自己名字命名的失败尝试开玩笑，而场馆外仍有一块防水布遮盖着原定的新名称，以掩盖其尴尬。

body.en: Punchlines on president’s thwarted bid to have building named after him come thick and fast at Washington DC gala Outside the John F Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts , a giant tarpaulin remained in place to conceal Donald Trump’s humiliation. Guests entering the national arts complex on Sunday night could not see the section of its marble facade where Trump’s name was recently erased to comply with a court order. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在华盛顿特区的晚宴上，关于总统以他的名字命名的建筑的计划遭到挫败的妙语不断出现。在约翰·F·肯尼迪表演艺术中心外，一块巨大的防水布仍然保留在原地，以掩盖唐纳德·特朗普的羞辱。周日晚上进入国家艺术中心的客人看不到大理石外立面的部分，特朗普的名字最近被抹去了，以遵守法院的命令。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The public spectacle of a thwarted attempt at self-aggrandizement reminds us that pride often precedes a fall. Yahweh's word suggests that those who seek to exalt themselves may ultimately find themselves humbled.
reflection.zh: 这种公开的、未能成功自我抬举的场面提醒我们，骄傲往往在跌倒之前。雅伟的话语表明，那些寻求抬高自己的人最终可能会发现自己被降卑。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Andy Burnham to propose devolution plan in first major policy speech since launching bid for No 10 – UK politics live
title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆在竞选首相后的首次重大政策演讲中提出权力下放计划——英国政治直播

summary.en: Andy Burnham, a Member of Parliament, has announced a devolution plan as part of his bid to become Prime Minister. In his first major policy speech, he pledged to deliver "growth in every postcode" across the UK.
summary.zh: 议员安迪·伯纳姆在首次重大政策演讲中提出了权力下放计划，作为他竞选首相的一部分。他承诺在英国“每个邮政编码区”实现增长。

body.en: Makerfield MP and hopeful prime minister to pledge ‘growth in every postcode’ Starmer For an alternative view on whether Andy Burnham should take questions from the media after his speech this morning, this is from Alastair Campbell , Tony Blair’s former communications chief who now co-hosts the Rest is Politics podcast. If true that @andyburnham not taking media questions after speech today then good move. Speeches matter and when important should speak for themselves. A problem with Keir S communications was that he would make a speech, then take Qs and the broadcast journalists in particular would make it more about them and their “take” than him. If and when he becomes PM Burnham will be answerable to Parliament, not the showbiz style media coverage of politics. The blah factory will go into overdrive today with journalists interviewing each other about how they ought to be allowed to ask Qs. The speech itself is more important than anything they say before during or after. Setting the agenda vital from the off. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马克菲尔德议员和充满希望的总理承诺“每个邮政编码的增长”斯塔默 对于安迪·伯纳姆今天早上演讲后是否应该接受媒体提问的另一种观点，这是来自托尼·布莱尔前通讯主管阿拉斯泰尔·坎贝尔的，他现在是“休息就是政治”播客的联合主持人。如果@andyburnham 今天演讲后没有接受媒体提问，那么这是一个很好的举动。演讲很重要，重要的时候应该不言而喻。 Keir S 通讯的一个问题是，他会发表演讲，然后接受 Q，尤其是广播记者会比他更多地谈论他们和他们的“观点”。如果伯纳姆成为总理，他将向议会负责，而不是演艺界风格的媒体对政治的报道。今天，废话工厂将进入超速状态，记者们互相采访，讨论如何允许他们提出问题。演讲本身比他们之前、期间或之后所说的任何事情都更重要。从一开始就制定至关重要的议程。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As leaders propose visions for national prosperity, the ancient mandate for justice and righteousness remains foundational. Yahweh calls those in authority to ensure fair treatment and protection for all, especially the vulnerable. A commitment to "growth in every postcode" reflects this divine expectation for equitable care across the land.
reflection.zh: 当领袖们提出国家繁荣的愿景时，古老的公义和正直的使命依然是根本。雅伟呼召掌权者确保所有人，特别是弱势群体，得到公平对待和保护。“每个邮政编码区”的增长承诺，正体现了雅伟对全国各地公平关怀的期待。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Venezuela in ‘critical hours’ to find earthquake survivors as more search and rescue teams arrive – latest updates
title.zh: 委内瑞拉进入寻找地震幸存者的“关键时刻”，更多搜救队抵达——最新进展

summary.en: Venezuelan officials are in a race against time to find survivors trapped under rubble after a devastating earthquake. The death toll has risen to at least 1,450, with thousands more injured, and is expected to increase as rescue efforts continue.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉官员正与时间赛跑，以寻找被困在瓦砾下的地震幸存者。地震造成的死亡人数已上升至至少1,450人，另有数千人受伤，预计随着救援工作的继续，死亡人数还会增加。

body.en:
The president of Venezuela’s National Assembly has warned time is running out to rescue survivors trapped under the rubble.

The death toll from the earthquakes has risen to at least 1,450 people, with 3,150 injured and 12,721 others displaced, Jorge Rodríguez said yesterday in a televised address.

“We are in critical hours, in crucial hours to continue rescuing lives and to build camps where those people who have lost their homes, or who cannot return, for whatever reason, to their residences can stay,” Rodríguez said.

More search and rescue teams are arriving in Venezuela five days after the powerful 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes struck within a minute of each other on Wednesday evening, flattening buildings in the north of the country.

The second quake was one of the strongest tremors to hit Venezuela in a century. At least 68,900 people have been reported unaccounted for by their families.

Experts say the first 72 hours after natural disasters define the narrow window for rescuing the living. After that the search usually becomes one of recovering bodies.

Venezuela’s acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, says power has been restored to La Guaira, a port city near the country’s main international airport badly affected by the earthquakes.

But there is a severe shortage of heavy machinery needed to rescue survivors and state manpower has been lacking, meaning the government is reliant on international aid for assistance.
body.zh: 委内瑞拉国民议会议长警告说，救援被困在废墟下的幸存者的时间已经不多了。 豪尔赫·罗德里格斯昨天在电视讲话中表示，地震造成的死亡人数已上升至至少 1,450 人，其中 3,150 人受伤，12,721 人流离失所。 罗德里格斯说：“我们正处于关键时刻，在继续拯救生命并建造营地的关键时刻，让那些失去家园或因任何原因无法返回住所的人可以居住。” 周三晚间，委内瑞拉发生一分钟内发生的 7.2 级和 7.5 级地震，导致该国北部的建筑物被夷为平地，五天后，更多的搜救队抵达委内瑞拉。 第二次地震是委内瑞拉一个世纪以来最强烈的地震之一。据报道，至少 68,900 人的家人下落不明。 专家表示，自然灾害发生后的前 72 小时是救援生者的时间窗口。此后，搜索通常成为寻找尸体的过程之一。 委内瑞拉代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯表示，拉瓜伊拉已经恢复供电，拉瓜伊拉是该国主要国际机场附近的一个港口城市，受地震影响严重。 但救援幸存者所需的重型机械严重短缺，国家人力也一直缺乏，这意味着政府依赖国际援助。

reflection.en: In the wake of such devastating loss and the desperate search for life, our hearts ache with those who suffer. Revelation 21:4 reminds us of Yahweh's promise to one day wipe away every tear, where death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. This hope anchors us even as we grieve with those facing unimaginable tragedy today.
reflection.zh: 面对如此毁灭性的损失和绝望的生命搜寻，我们的心与受苦之人同痛。启示录21:4提醒我们雅伟的应许，有一天祂将擦去所有的眼泪，不再有死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛。这份盼望在今日我们与面对难以想象的悲剧之人一同哀伤时，成为我们的锚。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Extreme heat continues in central and eastern Europe with temperatures of 38C expected – Europe live
title.zh: 中欧和东欧持续极端高温，预计气温将达到38摄氏度——欧洲实时报道

summary.en: Central and eastern Europe are experiencing an extreme heatwave, with temperatures reaching over 40C in Germany, Czechia, Poland, and Hungary. The Czech Republic, like much of Europe, has been dealing with unprecedented heat for the past two weeks.
summary.zh: 中欧和东欧持续经历极端热浪，德国、捷克、波兰和匈牙利的气温已超过40摄氏度。与欧洲大部分地区一样，捷克共和国在过去两周内一直面临前所未有的高温。

reflection.en: The intense heatwave across Europe reminds us of the profound interconnectedness between humanity and the natural world. As creation groans under environmental stress, we are called to reflect on our role and responsibility in stewarding the earth Yahweh has entrusted to us. This shared experience of a struggling planet can deepen our empathy and inspire...
reflection.zh: 欧洲各地持续的强烈热浪提醒我们，人类与自然世界之间存在深刻的相互关联。当受造界在环境压力下发出叹息时，我们被呼召反思自己在管理雅伟所托付的地球上的角色和责任。这种地球挣扎的共同经历可以加深我们的同理心，并激励我们为共同的家园采取集体行动。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: British American Tobacco to slash 9,000 jobs as it turns to AI
title.zh: 英美烟草公司转向人工智能，将裁员9,000人

summary.en: British American Tobacco (BAT) plans to eliminate 9,000 jobs, approximately a fifth of its global workforce, as part of a strategy to reduce costs and integrate more artificial intelligence and technology into its operations.
summary.zh: 英美烟草公司（BAT）计划裁员9,000人，约占其全球员工总数的五分之一，此举旨在削减成本并进一步将人工智能和技术融入其运营。

body.en: Dunhill maker to cut about a fifth of workforce, aiming to reduce costs and become more ‘technology enabled’ Business live – latest updates British American Tobacco (BAT) will cut about a fifth of its 47,000-strong workforce this year, as the cigarette-maker looks for ways to push down costs and become more “technology enabled”. BAT, which is one of the biggest tobacco groups in the world , has announced it will cut 5,500 jobs by the end of the year and outsource a further 3,500, affecting a ⁠total of 9,000 employees. Continue reading...
body.zh: 登喜路制造商将裁员约五分之一，旨在降低成本并变得更加“技术驱动” 商业直播 - 最新动态 英美烟草 (BAT) 今年将裁减其 47,000 名员工中的约五分之一，因为这家卷烟制造商正在寻求降低成本并变得更加“技术驱动”的方法。全球最大的烟草集团之一英美烟草公司宣布，将在今年年底前裁员 5,500 人，并再外包 3,500 人，总共影响 9,000 名员工。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As companies increasingly adopt AI for efficiency, stories like this prompt us to consider the human cost of technological advancement. Yahweh's wisdom reminds us that while knowledge can bring progress, it is love that truly builds up and sustains communities.
reflection.zh: 随着公司日益采用人工智能以提高效率，这样的新闻促使我们思考技术进步背后的人力成本。雅伟的智慧提醒我们，知识固然能带来进步，但唯有爱才能真正建立和维系社群。

verse.textEn: Knowledge puffs up while love builds up.
verse.textZh: 知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。

title.en: Top South African police officer survives assassination attempt
title.zh: 南非高级警官暗杀未遂幸存

summary.en: Maj-Gen Feroz Khan, the deputy crime intelligence boss in South Africa, survived an assassination attempt. He was scheduled to appear before an inquiry into police corruption this week.
summary.zh: 南非犯罪情报部门副主管费罗兹·汗少将遭遇暗杀未遂。他原定于本周出席一项针对警方腐败的调查听证会。

body.en:
One of South Africa's most senior police officers has survived an attempted assassination in Johannesburg, police say.

Deputy crime intelligence boss Maj-Gen Feroz Khan was shot on Sunday evening as he was driving home and has since been rushed to hospital for emergency surgery, local media say.

The shooting comes just days before Khan was due to appear before a public inquiry set up to investigate criminality in South Africa's police force.

South African police spokesperson Brig Athlenda Mathe said in a statement released on Monday that police were investigating.

"It is premature and irresponsible to speculate on any possible motive or to conclude that the incident is linked to his anticipated appearance before the [inquiry]", she said.

The inquiry, known as the Madlanga commission, was set up after senior police officer Lt-Gen Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi alleged last July that organised crime groups had infiltrated the government.

Khan, and two other people, were arrested last month for alleged illegal dealing in, and unlawful possession of, precious metals.

This stems from a 2021 incident when a businessman was found with unwrought gold weighing 75.9g (2.7 oz) at Johannesburg's OR Tambo international airport.

The businessman claimed he was acting as an undercover agent linked to senior police officers when questioned.

Investigators later found that "no authorised undercover operation involving precious metals existed at the time" but instead Khan, and another officer "instructed officers" to release the businessman, prosecutors said in May.
body.zh: 警方称，南非一名最高级别的警官在约翰内斯堡的一次暗杀未遂事件中幸存。 当地媒体称，犯罪情报副局长费罗兹·汗少将周日晚上开车回家时被枪杀，随后被送往医院接受紧急手术。 枪击事件发生前几天，汗将出席一项旨在调查南非警察部队犯罪行为的公开调查。 南非警方发言人布里格·阿特伦达·马特在周一发布的一份声明中表示，警方正在进行调查。 她说：“推测任何可能的动机或得出该事件与他在[调查]前预期露面有关的结论都是不成熟和不负责任的。” 这项名为“马德兰加委员会”的调查是在高级警官 Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi 中将去年 7 月指控有组织犯罪团伙渗透到政府后成立的。 汗和另外两人上个月因涉嫌非法交易和非法持有贵金属而被捕。 这源于 2021 年的一起事件，当时一名商人在约翰内斯堡的奥利弗·雷金纳德·坦博国际机场被发现携带重 75.9 克（2.7 盎司）的未锻造黄金。 该商人在接受询问时声称，他是一名与高级警官有联系的卧底特工。 检察官五月份表示，调查人员后来发现“当时不存在涉及贵金属的授权卧底行动”，而是汗和另一名警官“指示警官”释放了这名商人。

reflection.en: The attempted assassination of a senior police officer investigating corruption highlights the profound challenges faced when justice is perverted. Habakkuk 1:4 laments how “the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted,” a stark reality when those seeking accountability are targeted. Yet, even in such darkness, Yahweh sees and hears the...
reflection.zh: 一名调查腐败的高级警官遭遇暗杀未遂，这凸显了当正义被扭曲时所面临的严峻挑战。哈巴谷书1:4哀叹“恶人围困义人，所以公理颠倒”，当寻求问责的人成为目标时，这便是一个严酷的现实。然而，即使在这样的黑暗中，雅伟也看见并听见对公义的呼求。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Pakistani strikes kill dozens in Afghanistan
title.zh: 巴基斯坦空袭阿富汗造成数十人死亡

summary.en: Pakistan conducted strikes in Afghanistan, which the Taliban government claims killed civilians. Pakistan, however, states its targets were militants.
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦在阿富汗发动空袭，塔利班政府称造成平民死亡，而巴基斯坦则坚称其目标是武装分子。

body.en:
Pakistan launched airstrikes and sent ground troops into Afghan provinces along its border on Sunday, killing dozens.

At least 36 civilians, including women and children, have been killed and more than 160 others wounded, says Afghanistan's Taliban government, and has condemned it as a "cowardly act" and "a crime and atrocity".

Pakistan's information minister Attaullah Tarar said 29 militants were killed in strikes targeted at their hideouts, adding that the strikes were a response to "recent terrorist attacks against innocent people".

Pakistan has long accused Afghanistan of harbouring terror groups that carry out cross-border attacks, a claim the Taliban government rejects.

Kabul, in turn, has previously accused Islamabad of carrying out unprovoked attacks in which civilians were killed - though Pakistan says it only targets militants.

The two countries had agreed to a ceasefire last October following weeks of deadly clashes . As with past internationally-mediated truce deals, however, that ceasefire has since fallen apart.

The BBC has not independently confirmed the casualty figures claimed by the Pakistani and Taliban governments in the latest attacks.

Afghanistan's Taliban government says the strikes hit civilian homes, while Pakistan says they were targeted at militant hideouts in Afghanistan's Paktia, Paktika and Kunar provinces.

Casualties were concentrated in Mandokhail, a village in the Paktika province, Taliban officials say.

The attacks on Sunday come a day after three members of the Sindh Rangers, a Pakistani paramilitary force, were killed at their headquarters in Karachi, according to Pakistan's military. Three militants also died in the suicide attack, and Pakistani officials said they had arrested a fourth, who was an Afghan.

Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, a splinter faction of the TTP, claimed responsibility for Saturday's attack.

Both the TTP, also known as the Pakistan Taliban, and Jamaat-ul-Ahrar are banned in Pakistan, and by the United Nations, because of their involvement in past attacks.

Intermittent border clashes and airstrikes in the border area have killed dozens of people in recent months, according to officials in both countries.

In February, clashes between the two countries left dozens of people dead. In March, a Pakistani strike on a drug rehabilitation centre in Kabul killed hundreds.

Earlier in June, Pakistan launched deadly air strikes that killed 26 militants. Afghanistan's Taliban government said 13 people, mostly children, were also killed in the strikes.
body.zh: 周日，巴基斯坦发动空袭，并向阿富汗边境省份派遣地面部队，造成数十人死亡。 阿富汗塔利班政府表示，至少有 36 名平民（包括妇女和儿童）被杀，160 多人受伤，并谴责这是一种“懦夫行为”和“犯罪和暴行”。 巴基斯坦信息部长阿塔乌拉·塔拉尔表示，29名武装分子在针对其藏身之处的袭击中被打死，并补充说，这些袭击是对“最近针对无辜人民的恐怖袭击”的回应。 巴基斯坦长期以来一直指责阿富汗窝藏进行跨境袭击的恐怖组织，但塔利班政府否认了这一说法。 喀布尔此前曾指责伊斯兰堡发动无端袭击，造成平民死亡，不过巴基斯坦表示，袭击只针对武装分子。 在经历了数周的致命冲突后，两国于去年十月同意停火。然而，与过去国际斡旋的停火协议一样，停火协议已经破裂。 BBC尚未独立证实巴基斯坦和塔利班政府声称的最新袭击事件中的伤亡数字。 阿富汗塔利班政府表示，袭击针对的是平民住宅，而巴基斯坦则表示，袭击目标是阿富汗帕克蒂亚省、帕克蒂卡省和库纳尔省的武装分子藏身之处。 塔利班官员称，伤亡人员集中在帕克蒂卡省的一个村庄曼多哈伊尔。 据巴基斯坦军方称，周日袭击发生前一天，巴基斯坦准军事部队信德游骑兵队的三名成员在卡拉奇总部被杀。三名武装分子也在自杀式袭击中死亡，巴基斯坦官员表示，他们逮捕了第四名武装分子，他是阿富汗人。 TTP 的一个分裂派系“自由大会党”声称对周六的袭击事件负责。 TTP（也称为巴基斯坦塔利班）和自由党都因参与过去的袭击而被巴基斯坦和联合国禁止。 据两国官员称，近几个月来，边境地区间歇性的边境冲突和空袭已造成数十人死亡。 2月份，两国之间的冲突造成数十人死亡。三月，巴基斯坦对喀布尔戒毒中心的袭击造成数百人死亡。 6月初，巴基斯坦发动致命空袭，造成26名武装分子死亡。阿富汗塔利班政府表示，袭击中还造成 13 人死亡，其中大部分是儿童。

reflection.en: This tragic news highlights the devastating impact of conflict, where cycles of violence often claim innocent lives. Yahweh's word reminds us not to be overcome by evil, but to seek ways to overcome evil with good, even amidst profound challenges. This calls for a commitment to breaking cycles of harm and pursuing paths that lead to lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 这则悲剧性的新闻凸显了冲突的毁灭性影响，暴力循环常常夺走无辜的生命。雅伟的话语提醒我们不要被恶所胜，而要寻求以善胜恶，即便面对严峻的挑战。这呼唤着我们致力于打破伤害的循环，并寻求通往持久和平的道路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Indian journalists condemn 'denial' of voting and passport rights of prominent editor
title.zh: 印度记者谴责知名编辑被“剥夺”投票权和护照权利

summary.en: Indian journalists have condemned the alleged denial of voting and passport rights to a prominent editor, Rajagopal, who claims his name was removed from electoral rolls, preventing him from renewing his passport.
summary.zh: 印度记者谴责一名知名编辑被“剥夺”投票权和护照权利的指控。拉贾戈帕尔声称，他的名字被从选民名单中删除后，他无法更新护照。

body.en:
A leading journalists' body in India has condemned what it says is the denial of voting and passport rights to a former editor.

R Rajagopal, who worked at The Telegraph newspaper, says , external his passport renewal was held up after his name was removed from the electoral roll in West Bengal during a controversial voter list revision .

Known as the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), the exercise is being carried out by the Election Commission of India (ECI) to identify ineligible voters. Critics say it has wrongly removed millions of eligible voters, a charge the ECI rejects.

In a statement on Sunday, the Editors Guild of India said Rajagopal's case "highlights the misery that millions of Indians are being put through" because of the SIR exercise.

It added that if an influential public figure like Rajagopal could be stripped of his voting rights, the plight of ordinary Indians was likely to be far worse.

The ECI has not publicly responded to the specific allegations about Rajagopal. The BBC has reached out to officials for comment.

Since the SIR exercise began on 4 November 2025 across 12 states and federally administered territories, about 60 million names have been removed from the electoral rolls.

Around nine million of those were in West Bengal. Rajagopal is among the thousands who have appealed the decision in court.

Another phase of the exercise is under way in 16 states and three federally-administered territories.

In an article published by news website The Wire, Rajagopal wrote that despite living in Kolkata's Ballygunge constituency for more than 25 years, his name was removed because neither his nor his father's name could be found in the 2002 electoral rolls.

The SIR process verifies current voter records against the 2002 electoral rolls, the last time such a nationwide revision was carried out.

Rajagopal wrote that his name had been removed despite being a voter since 2010 and serving as editor of the Kolkata-based The Telegraph for seven years.

"No reason was furnished for my exclusion [from the voters' list] even after I submitted my matriculation certificate, and my appeal is now pending before one of the tribunals constituted pursuant to the Supreme Court's directions," he alleged in the article.

He said authorities later told him police verification for his passport renewal could not be completed because his name had been removed from the electoral roll.

"I was puzzled because I could not find any public document that listed the voter identity card as a mandatory document for passport renewal," he wrote.

The BBC has reached out to the Election Commission for a response to these allegations.

body.zh: 印度的一个主要记者机构谴责了其所称的剥夺前编辑投票权和护照权利的行为。 在《电讯报》工作的 R Rajagopal 表示，在一次有争议的选民名单修改过程中，他的名字从西孟加拉邦的选民名册中被删除，因此他的护照更新被推迟。 这项被称为“特别强化修订”（SIR）的工作由印度选举委员会（ECI）进行，旨在识别不合格的选民。批评者称，它错误地排除了数百万合格选民，但 ECI 否认了这一指控。 印度编辑协会在周日的一份声明中表示，拉贾戈帕尔的案件“凸显了数百万印度人因 SIR 演习而遭受的痛苦”。 报告补充说，如果像拉贾戈帕尔这样有影响力的公众人物被剥夺投票权，普通印度人的困境可能会更糟。 ECI 尚未公开回应有关拉贾戈帕尔的具体指控。 BBC 已联系官员征求评论。 自 2025 年 11 月 4 日在 12 个州和联邦直辖领地开始 SIR 演习以来，约 6000 万名字已从选民名册中删除。 其中约九百万人在西孟加拉邦。拉贾戈帕尔是数千名向法庭上诉的人之一。 另一阶段的演习正在 16 个州和三个联邦直辖地区进行。 拉贾戈帕尔在新闻网站《The Wire》发表的一篇文章中写道，尽管他在加尔各答的 Ballygunge 选区生活了 25 年多，但他的名字被删除了，因为他和他父亲的名字都没有出现在 2002 年的选民名册中。 SIR 程序根据 2002 年的选民名册核实当前选民记录，这是上次进行全国性修订的一次。 拉贾戈帕尔写道，尽管他自 2010 年起成为选民，并担任加尔各答《电讯报》编辑七年，但他的名字已被删除。 他在文章中声称：“即使在我提交了入学证明之后，也没有提供任何理由将我从选民名单中除名，而且我的上诉目前正在根据最高法院的指示组成的一个法庭等待审理。” 他说，当局后来告诉他，警方无法完成护照续签的核实，因为他的名字已从选民名册中删除。 他写道：“我很困惑，因为我找不到任何公开文件将选民身份证列为更新护照的强制性文件。” BBC 已联系选举委员会，要求其对这些指控做出回应。 “如果一个从事新闻职业并编辑一份相对知名报纸的人会遇到这样的……

Such actions highlight the constant need for vigilance and advocacy to uphold fundamental...
reflection.zh: 当掌权者利用行政手段压制或损害公民利益时，这会破坏公正社会所必需的信任。雅伟的话语提醒我们，邪恶的统治者，如同危险的掠食者，会给他们本应服务的民众带来苦难。此类行为凸显了持续警惕和倡导的重要性，以维护基本权利并确保公正治理。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Mum of newborn rescued from Venezuela rubble tells BBC baby motivated her to survive
title.zh: 从委内瑞拉废墟中获救新生儿的母亲告诉BBC，是婴儿激励她活了下来

summary.en: An 18-day-old baby, Juan David, was miraculously rescued from rubble in Venezuela following devastating earthquakes. His mother stated that the baby's presence motivated her to survive the ordeal, making the infant a symbol of hope for the nation.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉发生毁灭性地震后，一名出生18天的婴儿胡安·大卫奇迹般地从废墟中获救。他的母亲表示，正是这个婴儿激励她活了下来，使这个新生儿成为该国的希望象征。

body.en:
A mother who was pulled from the rubble of her wrecked home in Venezuela with her 18-day-old baby has told the BBC of how her son helped keep her alive.

Dayana Patino said her son Juan David gave her "motivation to be awake and alert".

"As long as he was alive, I was going to be alive. Every now and then I was touching his nose for proof that he was still breathing," she said.

Footage of the rescue has been shared around the world, with Juan David becoming a symbol of hope in Venezuela, which has been devastated by the twin earthquakes that hit the country on Wednesday - killing at least 1,450 people.

Search efforts are continuing, but hopes are diminishing that more survivors will be found .

At a clinic in the Venezuelan capital Caracas on Sunday, Dayana told the BBC of the terrifying hours she had spent underground, holding her tiny son close and praying that they would be saved.

She had been doing the washing up in her eighth-floor apartment in the northern coastal region of La Guaira when the earthquakes hit. She instantly rushed to cradle her son, thinking it would be "only a light tremor".

"I felt like I was flying. After that, I felt like I was sinking in water and dirt, and then I fell into the pit where I remained. I don't know how I didn't let go of my baby because I was flying. I got crushed against furniture," she said.

Instantly, she said she started to scream but soon realised that no one could hear her.

"I said to myself I'm not going to waste my energy - I'm going to scream when it's needed, when I hear voices or steps nearby," she said.

"I don't know how I kept so calm because my left leg was trapped under concrete. I couldn't move. My temple was pressed against a rock."

In the darkness of the rubble, she could see a "pinprick of light that looked like the moon".

"I said to myself, this is my only chance. From the top of my lungs I cried out… I screamed 'Here I am' with all my might, and he said 'I found you, and I promise you that I won't leave until I get you out'."

He kept that promise, and a delicate rescue operation followed to bring both mother and baby out of the rubble on Thursday night.

Dayana suffered injuries to both of her legs when the earthquake hit, while Juan fortunately only sustained minor injuries.

Dayana's husband Gerson had just returned home and parked the car when the earthquakes hit. He managed to jump over a fence to safety.

In widely shared footage of the rescue, Gerson can be seen clenching his eyes shut and tilting his head back to the sky as he embraces his son, overwhelmed with emotion.

"It was indescribable. I thought they were dead. And when I saw my son I felt like I was born again. I couldn't believe it… I felt the life come back to me," he told the BBC of that moment.

body.zh: 一位母亲带着她 18 天大的婴儿从委内瑞拉被毁的房屋废墟中被救出，她向 BBC 讲述了她的儿子如何帮助她活下去。 达亚娜·帕蒂诺说，她的儿子胡安·大卫给了她“保持清醒和警觉的动力”。 “只要他还活着，我就还活着。我时不时地触摸他的鼻子，以证明他还在呼吸，”她说。 救援视频已在世界各地传播，胡安·大卫成为委内瑞拉希望的象征，该国因周三袭击该国的两次地震而遭受重创，造成至少 1,450 人死亡。 搜寻工作仍在继续，但找到更多幸存者的希望正在减弱。 周日，在委内瑞拉首都加拉加斯的一家诊所，达亚娜向英国广播公司讲述了她在地下度过的可怕时光，紧紧抱着她的小儿子，祈祷他们能获救。 地震发生时，她正在拉瓜伊拉北部沿海地区八楼的公寓里洗碗。她立即​​冲过去抱住儿子，以为这只是“轻微的颤抖”。 “我感觉自己在飞翔。之后，我感觉自己陷入了水和泥土中，然后我掉进了我留下的坑里。我不知道我是如何没有放开我的孩子的，因为我在飞翔。我被家具压住了，”她说。 她说她立即开始尖叫，但很快意识到没有人能听到她的声音。 “我对自己说，我不会浪费我的精力——当需要的时候，当我听到附近的声音或脚步声时，我会尖叫，”她说。 “我不知道我是如何保持如此冷静的，因为我的左腿被困在混凝土下。我无法动弹。我的太阳穴被压在岩石上。” 在黑暗的瓦砾中，她可以看到“像月亮一样的针刺光”。 “我对自己说，这是我唯一的机会。我从肺腑大声呼喊……我竭尽全力尖叫‘我在这里’，他说‘我找到了你，我向你保证，在我把你救出来之前我不会离开’。” 他信守了这一承诺，随后进行了一场细致的救援行动，于周四晚上将母亲和婴儿从废墟中救了出来。 地震发生时，达亚娜的双腿受伤，而胡安幸运的是只受了轻伤。 地震发生时，达亚娜的丈夫格尔森刚刚回家停好车。他设法跳过栅栏到达安全地带。 在广为流传的救援视频中，可以看到格尔森紧闭双眼，仰起头仰望天空，拥抱着儿子，情绪激动不已。 “这是难以形容的。我以为他们死了。当我看到我的儿子时，我感觉自己重生了。我简直不敢相信......我感觉生命又回到了我身边，”他告诉英国广播公司那一刻。 格尔森和...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of devastating earthquakes, the rescue of baby Juan David and his mother's testimony remind us that even in profound suffering, hope can emerge. Yahweh often uses trials to forge resilience and a deeper sense of purpose, turning moments of despair into symbols of enduring life.
reflection.zh: 在毁灭性地震之后，婴儿胡安·大卫的获救以及他母亲的见证提醒我们，即使在深重的苦难中，希望也能萌芽。雅伟常常借着试炼来磨砺韧性并深化生命的意义，将绝望的时刻转化为持久生命的象征。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: South Korea football coach quits as president calls for probe into World Cup loss
title.zh: 韩国足球教练辞职，总统要求调查世界杯失利

summary.en: South Korea's national football coach has resigned after the team's elimination from the World Cup, failing to secure a spot among the top eight third-placed teams. The country's president has subsequently called for an investigation into the loss.
summary.zh: 韩国国家足球队在世界杯中被淘汰，未能进入八强最佳小组第三名，主教练因此辞职。韩国总统随后呼吁对此次失利进行调查。

body.en:
Hong Myung-bo has resigned as head coach of South Korea's men's national football team after they failed to advance to the World Cup knockout stage.

The team had hoped they could still qualify for the next round of the tournament as one of the best third-placed teams, but that hope was quashed on Saturday.

The early exit has prompted widespread criticism at home, with President Lee Jae Myung calling for an investigation into reasons behind the team's disappointing performance.

Hong apologised to fans on Sunday and said the responsibility "rests entirely with me as head coach".

Ranked 32nd in FIFA's men's rankings and led by star player Son Heung-min, South Korea recorded two losses and one win at the World Cup, finishing behind Mexico and South Africa, who are ranked 15th and 60th respectively.

Criticism had mounted quickly after the team's last match with South Africa on Thursday, which South Korea lost 1-0.

The defeat left them third in Group A. It still gave them hope to qualify for the next round under a new rule introduced with this tournament's expansion from 32 to 48 teams, which allows the eight best third-placed teams in the group stage to progress to the knockout round. But on Saturday, they were knocked out because of the other teams' final scores.

Fans blame Hong, who has been coaching the team for the past two years. On Monday, the national team's official fan club Red Devils issued a statement calling on Hong to "kneel before the entire nation and leave the football world forever".

Announcing his resignation at a news conference in Mexico on Sunday, Hong said that "we didn't deliver the results that our fans expected".

"Even though I am leaving the national team, I am not abandoning Korean football altogether," Hong said. "I will cheer for the national team from the bottom of my heart and hope that the team will be trusted and loved by the people once again."

The announcement came after President Lee said that he felt "not just confusion but utter bewilderment at the unexpected outcome".

In a post on X, Lee said that the early exit of the team "appears to be a failure of organisation and personnel".

"When favouritism and cronyism take precedence over competence in selecting a commander, the result is as predictable as fire burning paper," he said.

Hong's appointment to the head coach post was controversial from the start. The former defender was a hero of South Korea's 2002 World Cup success, having captained the team to a historic semi-final finish. But when he led the team as a coach in 2014, they failed to advance beyond the group stage - or win a single match.

reflection.en: The intense disappointment following a World Cup loss, leading to a coach's resignation and a presidential probe, highlights the fleeting nature of earthly achievements. While striving for excellence is commendable, this moment reminds us that the crowns we pursue in this life are ultimately perishable. True discipline and effort find their deepest meaning...
reflection.zh: 世界杯失利后，教练辞职并引发总统调查，这种强烈的失望凸显了世俗成就的短暂性。虽然追求卓越值得称赞，但这一刻提醒我们，今生所追求的冠冕终将朽坏。真正的纪律和努力，当它们指向那永不朽坏的奖赏时，才能找到最深刻的意义。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: 'I'm a rare breed': The Aussie firefighter inside Venezuela's desperate quake rescue
title.zh: “我是一个稀有物种”：这位澳大利亚消防员深入委内瑞拉绝望的地震救援

summary.en: With no Spanish or local contacts, Craig De Meillon flew to Venezuela to help search for earthquake survivors.
summary.zh: 在没有西班牙语能力和当地联系人的情况下，克雷格·德·梅隆飞往委内瑞拉，协助搜寻地震幸存者。

body.en:
When Craig De Meillon learned of the devastating earthquakes that struck northern Venezuela last week, he messaged his boss.

Born in South Africa but growing up on the Gold Coast, De Meillon was getting ready to watch the Socceroos play Paraguay on Friday from his home in Miami, Florida, when he realised he was needed.

"I was like, 'Hey, is it cool if I take leave? Because I'm going to go do this whole save the world thing,'" De Meillon tells SBS News over the phone from Caraballeda, the capital of the worst-affected La Guaira state.

The twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela on Thursday have left some 50,000 people missing, 6.8 million people impacted, and at least 1,450 dead. The United Nations' death toll is expected to increase dramatically.

For De Meillon, a volunteer firefighter, this will be his fourth earthquake disaster recovery.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I'm kind of, like, special in the sense that I'll just get there sooner than most people can move," De Meillon said. "I just kind of dropped everything and got on a flight."

With no Spanish and no local contacts, De Meillon quickly found his decade of disaster relief experience in desperate need as the crucial 72-hour window for finding survivors under the rubble ticked by.

Having previously worked with NGOs to respond to earthquakes in Türkiye, Indonesia, and Nepal, De Meillon knew that operating independently with a team of other experienced volunteers would give him greater flexibility. He also knows that "going rogue" and self-deploying is a "big no-no" in disaster response, but there was no time to wait.

"I'm formally trained, I've got a skill, it's being underused... It worked out well, and we pulled a lot of people alive."

The recent political turmoil between the United States and Venezuela — during which the US seized long-time leader Nicolás Maduro in a stunning raid — has meant entry into the country is challenging for US citizens and, as a result, foreign aid workers seem thin on the ground, De Meillon said.

The 43-year-old with a corporate day job describes residential buildings thrown sideways by the 7.2- and 7.5-magnitude quakes, no electricity, no internet or mobile coverage, and very few basic services like running water and food. Thousands of people have become homeless overnight.

The Venezuelan government, led by interim president Delcy Rodríguez, has declared a national state of emergency and said at least 3,150 people have been injured. Some 774 buildings have been severely damaged by the back-to-back shocks that rocked the South American nation, and 189 have totally collapsed.

body.zh: 当克雷格·德梅永得知上周委内瑞拉北部发生毁灭性地震时，他给他的老板发了信息。 德梅永出生于南非，但在黄金海岸长大。周五，德梅永在佛罗里达州迈阿密的家中准备观看澳大利亚队对阵巴拉圭队的比赛时，他意识到球队需要他。 “我当时想，‘嘿，如果我请假是不是很酷？因为我要去拯救世界，’”德梅永在受灾最严重的拉瓜伊拉州首府卡拉巴莱达通过电话告诉 SBS 新闻。 周四袭击委内瑞拉的两次地震已导致约 5 万人失踪、680 万人受到影响、至少 1,450 人死亡。联合国的死亡人数预计将急剧增加。 对于志愿消防员德梅永来说，这将是他第四次地震灾后恢复。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我有点特别，因为我会比大多数人更早到达那里，”德梅永说。 “我只是放下了一切，登上了飞机。” 由于不懂西班牙语，也没有当地的联系人，德梅永很快发现自己十年的救灾经验迫切需要，因为在废墟下寻找幸存者的关键 72 小时窗口已经过去。 德梅永之前曾与非政府组织合作应对土耳其、印度尼西亚和尼泊尔的地震，他知道与其他经验丰富的志愿者团队一起独立行动将为他带来更大的灵活性。他也知道，“失控”和自行部署是灾难应对中的“大忌”，但已经没有时间等待了。 “我受过正规训练，我有一项技能，但它没有得到充分利用……效果很好，我们救了很多人。” 德梅永说，最近美国和委内瑞拉之间的政治动荡——美国在一次令人震惊的突袭中抓获了长期领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗——意味着美国公民进入该国面临挑战，因此，外国援助人员的数量似乎很少。 这位在公司上班的 43 岁老人描述了在 7.2 级和 7.5 级地震中住宅楼被推倒的情况，没有电，没有互联网或移动信号覆盖，自来水和食物等基本服务也很少。一夜之间，数千人无家可归。 由临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯领导的委内瑞拉政府已宣布全国进入紧急状态，并表示至少有 3,150 人受伤。南美国家接连发生的地震导致约 774 座建筑物严重受损，其中 189 座建筑物完全倒塌。 在拉瓜伊拉，德梅永描述了当地人......

reflection.en: The story of an Australian firefighter traveling to a foreign land to help strangers in crisis echoes the spirit of the Good Samaritan. His selfless act reminds us that compassion knows no borders or language barriers when a neighbor is in need. Yahweh calls us to extend kindness and aid to anyone suffering, regardless of their background.
reflection.zh: 一位澳大利亚消防员远赴异国，帮助身处危机的陌生人，这与好撒玛利亚人的精神不谋而合。他无私的行动提醒我们，当邻舍有需要时，怜悯之心不应受国界或语言的限制。雅伟呼召我们向所有受苦之人伸出援手，不分背景。

verse.textEn: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers? ... 'Go and do likewise.'
verse.textZh: 你想这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？……「你去照样行吧。」

title.en: Pakistan's Geo News apologizes for Muharram broadcast
title.zh: 巴基斯坦Geo News为穆哈兰月节目致歉

summary.en: Pakistan's media regulator suspended Geo News for 15 days after a documentary was deemed offensive to religious sentiments. The broadcaster subsequently issued an apology for the content.
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦媒体监管机构对Geo News电视台处以15天停播处罚，原因是其播出的一部纪录片被认为“可能伤害观众的宗教感情”。该电视台随后为此内容发表了道歉声明。

body.en:
The broadcaster Geo News was handed a 15-day suspension for a documentary that was "liable to hurt the religious sentiments of viewers," Pakistan's media watchdog said.

Pakistani broadcaster Geo News on Sunday apologized for airing a documentary after it was handed a 15-day suspension a day earlier.

Geo News said it apologized for the contents of the program "Safar-e-Ishq" that was transmitted during the sacred month of Muharram, the first month of the Islamic lunar calendar.

"Geo News has acknowledged an editorial error regarding content aired during its 10th Muharram transmission," the broadcaster said on its website.

It said that the program had shown "certain rituals practiced by a limited number of people in Iraq and some other Middle Eastern countries."

The Pakistan Electronic Media Regulatory Authority (PEMRA) said on Saturday that the "broadcast of such visual representation, given the religious, cultural and social sensitivities, constitutes a serious regulatory concern," adding that the program in question "was liable to hurt the religious sentiments of viewers… and create a risk of disturbance to public peace."

The statement also did not provide further details of the documentary's content.

Some members of Iraq's Shiite Muslim community carry out plays and processions depicting early Islamic figures, known as ta'ziyah, a practice typically discouraged by scholars from Islam's more widespread Sunni sect.

Most Pakistanis are Sunni Muslims, while some 10% belong to the Shiite minority. Tensions between the two groups have  led to clashes in the past .

Pakistan also has strict blasphemy laws that have at times stirred vigilante violence .

The South Asian country was placed 158th out of 180 countries ranked on Reporters Without Borders (RSF)'s Press Freedom Index in 2025.

body.zh: 巴基斯坦媒体监管机构称，Geo News 广播公司因一部“可能伤害观众宗教感情”的纪录片而被停播 15 天。 巴基斯坦广播公司 Geo News 周日为播出一部纪录片而道歉，该纪录片前一天被暂停 15 天。 Geo News 表示，它对在伊斯兰农历第一个月神圣的穆哈拉姆月期间播出的节目“Safar-e-Ishq”的内容表示歉意。 该广播公司在其网站上表示：“Geo News 承认在其第十次回历月传输期间播放的内容存在编辑错误。” 据称，该节目展示了“伊拉克和其他一些中东国家的少数人进行的某些仪式”。 巴基斯坦电子媒体监管局（PEMRA）周六表示，“考虑到宗教、文化和社会敏感性，播放此类视觉表现形式构成了严重的监管问题”，并补充说，相关节目“可能会伤害观众的宗教情感……并造成扰乱公共和平的风险。” 声明也没有提供纪录片内容的进一步细节。 伊拉克什叶派穆斯林社区的一些成员表演描绘早期伊斯兰人物的戏剧和游行，称为“塔齐亚”，这种做法通常受到伊斯兰教更广泛的逊尼派学者的反对。 大多数巴基斯坦人是逊尼派穆斯林，约 10% 属于什叶派少数民族。这两个群体之间的紧张关系过去曾导致过冲突。 巴基斯坦也有严格的亵渎法，有时会引发私刑暴力。 在无国界记者组织 (RSF) 2025 年新闻自由指数排名中，这个南亚国家在 180 个国家中排名第 158 位。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: This incident reminds us of the profound impact our words and media can have on others, especially concerning deeply held beliefs. Reckless communication can cause significant pain, highlighting the importance of speaking with wisdom and care.
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，言语和媒体内容对他人，特别是对深层信仰，可能产生深远影响。鲁莽的传播会造成巨大的伤害，突显了以智慧和谨慎说话的重要性。

verse.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verse.textZh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

title.en: Uganda military chief shuts media outlets, slams 'free press'
title.zh: 乌干达军事首长关闭媒体，抨击“新闻自由”

summary.en: Uganda's military chief, Muhoozi Kainerugaba, who is the son of long-serving President Yoweri Museveni, has ordered the closure of media outlets, stating his disbelief in a free press.
summary.zh: 乌干达军事首长穆胡齐·凯内鲁加巴下令关闭媒体，并表示他不相信新闻自由。他是长期执政的总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼的儿子。

body.en:
Muhoozi Kainerugaba said that he issued the order as he does not "believe in a free press." He is the son of President Yoweri Museveni, who has held his grip on power for decades.

Ugandan military chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba on Sunday said that he had ordered the closure of two of Uganda's major media outlets.

Kainerugaba is the son of President Yoweri Museveni, who has led the country since 1986 .

In a series of posts on the platform X, Kainerugaba announced the closure of the Daily Monitor daily and the NTV broadcaster, insisting it was within the purview of powers delegated to him by the presidency.

"In Uganda, I do not believe in a ​free press! The press should be guided by cadres of the revolution," Kainerugaba said.

"I have the power in Uganda to shut down ANY media house I want to. I have had this power since 2017. This power was given to me by my great father President [Yoweri Museveni]," he said. "NTV and Daily Monitor are learning about it today."

He also said this was "just the beginning" and threatened to "arrest many more."

The comments were accompanied by a flurry of other posts on X over several hours that included vulgar jokes and insults and apparent threats of arrest directed against Ugandan public figures, as well as a post suggesting he wanted to expel all Turkish citizens from Uganda.

Kainerugaba has been touted as a possible successor to his father Museveni. He is known for controversial social media outbursts, including a post in which he threatened to behead opposition leader Bobi Wine .

Both the daily and the broadcaster are owned by the Kenya-based Nation Media Group (NMG).

The Daily Monitor reported on Sunday that military personnel had been deployed to NMG's headquarters in the Ugandan capital, Kampala.

It added that staff were prevented from entering or leaving the premises during the raid.

Uganda's National Association of Broadcasters said at least six NMG publishing and broadcasting outlets in Uganda were closed.

NMG managing director Susan Nsibirwa told Reuters news agency she did not have an immediate comment.

body.zh: 穆胡齐·凯内鲁加巴 (Muhoozi Kainerugaba) 表示，他发布这一命令是因为他不“相信新闻自由”。他是总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼 (Yoweri Museveni) 的儿子，后者掌权数十年。 乌干达军事首长穆胡齐·凯内鲁加巴周日表示，他已下令关闭乌干达两家主要媒体。 凯内鲁加巴是总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼 (Yoweri Museveni) 的儿子，穆塞韦尼自 1986 年以来一直领导该国。 在 X 平台上的一系列帖子中，凯内鲁加巴宣布关闭《每日观察》日报和 NTV 广播公司，坚称这属于总统授予他的权力范围。 “在乌干达，我不相信新闻自由！新闻界应该受到革命干部的指导，”凯内鲁加巴说。 “我在乌干达有权关闭任何我想要关闭的媒体机构。自 2017 年以来我就拥有这项权力。这项权力是我伟大的父亲总统 [约韦里·穆塞韦尼] 赋予我的，”他说。 “NTV 和 Daily Monitor 今天正在了解此事。” 他还表示，这“只是开始”，并威胁要“逮捕更多人”。 伴随这些评论的还有几个小时内 X 上的一系列其他帖子，其中包括针对乌干达公众人物的粗俗笑话和侮辱以及明显的逮捕威胁，以及暗示他想将所有土耳其公民驱逐出乌干达的帖子。 凯内鲁加巴被认为是他父亲穆塞韦尼的可能继任者。他因在社交媒体上爆发争议性言论而闻名，其中包括威胁要斩首反对党领袖波比·瓦恩的帖子。 该日报和广播公司均属于肯尼亚国家媒体集团 (NMG)。 《每日观察报》周日报道称，军事人员已被部署到位于乌干达首都坎帕拉的 NMG 总部。 它补充说，在突袭期间，工作人员被禁止进入或离开该场所。 乌干达全国广播协会表示，乌干达至少六家 NMG 出版和广播机构已关闭。 NMG 董事总经理 Susan Nsibirwa 告诉路透社，她没有立即发表评论。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队提供的可信报告，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终能够首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: When a free press is silenced, the public is deprived of vital information, hindering their ability to discern truth and make informed decisions. Yahweh's word reminds us that knowing the truth is essential for true freedom, and its suppression can lead to deeper forms of bondage.
reflection.zh: 当新闻自由被压制时，公众就被剥夺了重要信息，阻碍了他们辨别真相和做出明智决定的能力。雅伟的话语提醒我们，认识真理对真正的自由至关重要，而压制真理可能导致更深层次的束缚。

verse.textEn: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
verse.textZh: 你们必晓得真理，真理必叫你们得以自由。

title.en: Saudi Aramco helicopter crashes, all 14 passengers killed
title.zh: 沙特阿美公司直升机坠毁，机上14人全部遇难

summary.en: Saudi Arabian media reported that a Saudi Aramco helicopter crashed in Ras Tanura on the country's eastern coast early on Sunday. All 14 Saudi nationals on board were killed, and the cause of the crash remains unclear.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯媒体报道称，沙特阿美公司的一架直升机于周日凌晨在该国东海岸的拉斯坦努拉坠毁。机上14名沙特公民全部遇难，坠机原因尚不清楚。

body.zh: 沙特阿拉伯媒体报道称，这架直升机周日早些时候在该国东海岸的拉斯塔努拉坠毁。据称，机上14名沙特公民全部遇难，坠机原因尚不清楚。 据沙特阿拉伯国家通讯社报道，沙特石油巨头阿美公司的一架直升机周日凌晨在沙特阿拉伯东海岸霍尔木兹海峡以西的拉斯塔努拉坠毁。 在美伊战争和霍尔木兹海峡封锁期间停工数月后，该公司于周五恢复了 Ras Tanura 的装载，试图利用伊朗和美国之间达成的临时且摇摇欲坠的初步协议。 沙特通讯社援引能源部一位未透露姓名的官员的话说：“有关当局正在参与调查，以确定直升机坠毁的原因。” 报道称，机上所有 14 人均为沙特国民，坠机事件中无人生还。 据说事故发生在当地时间早上 6 点左右，距离消息开始传出还有几个小时。 沙特阿美公司是世界上最大的石油公司，其多数股权由沙特阿拉伯持有。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The sudden loss of 14 lives in this helicopter crash brings profound sorrow and reminds us of life's fragility. In moments of such tragedy, we hold onto the hope that one day, Yahweh will wipe away every tear and there will be no more death, mourning, crying, or pain. This promise offers comfort, assuring us that suffering is not the final word.

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Fact check: As Europe bakes, should you trust your sunscreen?
title.zh: 事实核查：欧洲酷热难耐，你的防晒霜值得信赖吗？

summary.en: As a heat wave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.
summary.zh: 欧洲热浪来袭，网上再次出现质疑防晒霜安全性及其与皮肤癌风险之间关联的说法。

body.en:
As a heat wave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.

Millions of people across Europe are dealing with  temperatures above 40 degrees Celsius  (104 degrees Fahrenheit), baking under a heat dome. Hot nights are making recovery harder.

While many recognize the need to use sunscreen to protect themselves from the sun , some people, particularly on social media, have been asking whether it could actually be harmful.

The discussion centers around the question of whether sunscreen could increase the risk of skin cancer, rather than reduce it.

And while the debate is not new, it does seem to be resurfacing more frequently, as global temperatures continue to rise and droughts and extreme heat become the new normal.

Claim: "According to the National Cancer Institute, since the introduction of sunscreen in 1940, melanoma has increased by over 200%."

This claim, archived here , has appeared on several social media platforms. It further describes sunscreen as a "poison" that prevents the body from properly absorbing sunlight.

First, several studies  have shown that regularly using sunscreen actually reduces the risk of developing melanoma.

"There is no scientific evidence that supports the association of sunscreen use with a higher risk of cancer," said Brittany Schaefer, public information officer with the Connecticut State Department of Public Health.

Schaefer spoke with DW in 2025, when the Fact check team debunked similar claims around sunscreen, especially the false assumption that the countries that use the most sunscreen have the highest incidence of skin cancer.

Second, the US National Cancer Institute  has not said sunscreen use caused a 200% increase in melanoma since 1940.

According to the data, the rate of newly diagnosed melanoma cases has increased by more than 220% from then to 2023.

However, there is no evidence linking the rise in melanoma cases to sunscreen use.

A 2023 study  involving scientists from the US, Germany, Switzerland and Hungary can provide some clues to understand why cases are on the rise.

This final point has also been highlighted by public surveys across several countries, despite recommendations that sunscreen should be used regularly.

In Germany, for example, 51% of respondents said in 2024 that they only use sunscreen in summer or when exposed to direct sunlight, while 17% said they never use it.

And in the United States, a poll conducted in the same year  found that 33% of adults admitted to never using sunscreen at all.

title.en: Iran again asserts control over Strait of Hormuz after Trump's Truth Social annihilation threat
title.zh: 特朗普言辞升级，称“伊朗伊斯兰共和国将不复存在”，休战协议受考验

summary.en: Iran has fired missiles and drones at US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, leading to an escalation in rhetoric from former President Trump, who stated the "Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist," further testing a fragile truce.
summary.zh: 伊朗向科威特和巴林境内的美国军事基地发射了导弹和无人机，导致前总统特朗普的言辞升级，他声称“伊朗伊斯兰共和国将不复存在”，这进一步考验了脆弱的休战协议。

body.en:
The Iranian foreign minister has warned that any challenge to his country's control of the Strait of Hormuz would increase tensions after a series of tit-for-tat attacks with the United States and social media threats of annihilation from the US president.

During a visit to Iraq on Sunday, Abbas Araghchi said: "Any attempt to adopt new or separate arrangements compared to what is underway by the Islamic Republic of Iran will only lead to more complicated situations and delays in the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and will increase the tensions, as we witnessed in the past two nights."

Araghchi called on all parties to "adhere to the memorandum of understanding and not to allow this MoU to deviate from its course" while proposing a new security framework with Gulf countries.

"We should reach a new framework that includes all countries in the region — and without the presence or interference of any country from outside the region," he said.

The comments came after US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that "the Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist" if the US was "forced" to resume the war, accusing Iran of violating the ceasefire.

"United States aircraft just struck Iranian missile and drone storage locations, and coastal radar sites, for violating the Cease Fire Agreement, AGAIN!" Trump wrote on Truth Social.

"There may come a point when we are no longer able to be reasonable, and will be forced to militarily complete the job that we very successfully started," he continued.

The clashes brought new tension to the negotiating process meant to end a war launched by the US and Israel at the end of February.

They also underlined the risks still facing one of the world's most important sea lanes for oil and other commodities.

US Central Command said it had struck 10 Iranian military targets in response to an Iranian drone attack on the Panama-flagged oil tanker Kiku, which was carrying some two million barrels of crude.

The US military said the response targeted "surveillance infrastructure, communication systems, air defense sites, drone storage facilities, and minelayer capabilities".

Iranian media reported several explosions in the Sirik and Qeshm areas of southern Iran.

In retaliation, Iran launched multiple missiles and drones toward neighbouring countries, including Bahrain and Kuwait.

The Bahraini military said it had "intercepted and destroyed a number of projectiles used in these treacherous Iranian attacks", adding that it was on "maximum alert".

title.en: 6.7 million people affected by Venezuela earthquakes, UN says, locals plead for more aid
title.zh: 联合国称委内瑞拉地震影响670万人，当地居民恳求更多援助

summary.en: A powerful earthquake in Venezuela has led to a rising death toll of nearly 1,500, with the United Nations reporting that 6.7 million people have been affected. Local residents are urgently appealing for increased humanitarian aid.

body.en:
Close to seven million people may have been impacted by the twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela on Thursday, leaving more than 1,400 dead.

The United Nations migration agency estimated on Sunday that "up to 6.76 million people could be affected by the devastating earthquakes".

The International Organization for Migration (IOM) projection highlights the "potentially vast humanitarian impact" of the disaster as locals on the ground claim the government is not responding quickly enough.

Venezuela's interim leader Delcy Rodríguez was booed during a visit to a neighbourhood in the capital Caracas that had been badly affected by the natural disaster.

"The government isn't doing anything for the people," residents yelled on Saturday, many of whom had loved ones trapped under the debris.

Three days after two powerful tremors of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 hit , 50,000 people are still missing. The death toll has risen to 1,430 people — according to National Assembly president Jorge Rodríguez — and fury with perceived governmental inaction is mounting.

As the first United States aid flight landed in Caracas, millions of Venezuelans are feared to lack sanitation and other basic needs.

Rodríguez has thanked the international community for the significant outpouring of aid.

However, local residents are being forced to desperately claw away rubble from collapsed apartment buildings.

Experts say the first 72 hours after natural disasters are the key, narrow window for finding the living.

"It's just very chaotic, hot and unorganised," Australian firefighter Craig De Meillon, 43, told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency. He travelled alone to La Guaira from Miami to help.

On Friday, UN aid chief Tom Fletcher told AFP the death toll could continue to soar.

One runway at Simon Bolivar International Airport is partially functioning for aid landings. A US naval ship has also arrived off the coast.

There was joy in the hardest-hit coastal area of La Guaira, north of Caracas, when locals pulled an infant alive out of the wreckage on Saturday, 32 hours after the initial shocks.

In one social media video, a man welled up in tears as he held the baby in his arms.

Already battered by years of a failing economy and the turbulence of the US intervention to abduct leader Nicolas Maduro in January , Venezuelans are increasingly expressing their anger with the government.

title.en: Socceroos knockout opponent confirmed after dramatic Group G finish
title.zh: 戏剧性的G组收官战后，澳大利亚队淘汰赛对手确定

summary.en: Australia's World Cup knockout stage opponent was determined in the final moments of the Group G matches, following a highly competitive group stage.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚队在世界杯淘汰赛阶段的对手，是在G组最后一场比赛的最后时刻才决定的，此前小组赛竞争异常激烈。

body.en:
Australia will face Egypt in the World Cup Round of 32 after the Pharaohs held on to finish second in Group G following a dramatic final round of matches.

Egypt sealed its place in the knockout rounds on Saturday afternoon (AEST) with a 1-1 draw against Iran, but was denied top spot in Group G after Belgium thrashed New Zealand 5-1 to edge the Pharaohs on goal difference.

That means Australia will face Egypt in the Round of 32 at Arlington, Texas, at 4am AEST next Saturday. The two sides have never met at a World Cup before.

It's still unclear whether Egyptian star player Mohamed Salah will play in the match.

Salah — who became one of the English Premier League's most celebrated players after signing with Liverpool in 2017 — came off in the 57th minute in the Egypt-Iran match and was seen having his left leg bandaged.

The Group G standings changed several times throughout the simultaneous matches, with Belgium, Iran and Egypt all sitting second in the group at various times.

In their match against Egypt , Iran scored a stoppage-time goal, which was ruled offside by VAR. Had the goal stood, Iran would have finished second and played Australia next Saturday.

They now face an agonising wait to see if they qualify as one of the top eight third-placed teams.

After a 1-5 defeat to Belgium, New Zealand finished last in the group with one point and were eliminated from the tournament.

Former Socceroo Harry Kewell, speaking before the results were announced, told SBS that Belgium and Egypt looked to be the most dangerous of Australia's opponents.

"Once you get through the group stages, which they successfully navigated through, it's all about now.

"This is where you have to play your best football. This is where you have to strike when your chances are low, you've got to be able to be clinical, and hopefully we can do that and progress one step further."

The challenge for the Australian side will be to play their best football with a couple of players out of action.

The Socceroos are down to a 24-player squad after the injured Jacob Italiano and Mathew Leckie left camp for Austria and Melbourne, respectively.

Italiano played against Türkiye and the United States but was injured at training, while Leckie hurt his hamstring in the side's 2-0 defeat to the US.

Australia have played Egypt twice before, winning a President's Cup match on penalties in 1987. They lost a friendly in Cairo 3-0 in 2010.

body.zh: 澳大利亚队将在世界杯 32 强赛中对阵埃及队，法老队在最后一轮比赛中戏剧性地保住了 G 组第二名的成绩。 周六下午（澳大利亚东部标准时间），埃及以 1-1 战平伊朗队锁定了淘汰赛席位，但在比利时 5-1 击败新西兰队，以净胜球优势击败法老队后，埃及队未能获得 G 组头名位置。 这意味着澳大利亚将于下周六凌晨 4 点在德克萨斯州阿灵顿举行的 32 强赛中对阵埃及。此前，两队从未在世界杯上交手过。 目前还不清楚埃及明星球员穆罕默德·萨拉赫是否会参加比赛。 萨拉赫在 2017 年与利物浦签约后成为英超最著名的球员之一，他在埃及与伊朗的比赛中第 57 分钟下场，人们看到他的左腿缠着绷带。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “当我们回到酒店时，医生会写出他的报告，并进行第二次检查。我和萨拉赫谈过，上帝保佑，伤势似乎并不严重，”哈桑说。 在同时进行的比赛中，G组的排名发生了多次变化，比利时、伊朗和埃及在不同时期都位居小组第二。 在对阵埃及的比赛中，伊朗队补时阶段打入一球，但被VAR判定越位。如果进球有效，伊朗队将获得第二名，并在下周六对阵澳大利亚队。 他们现在面临着痛苦的等待，看看自己是否有资格成为前八名第三名的球队之一。 新西兰队1-5负于比利时队后，积1分小组垫底，被淘汰出局。 前足球运动员哈里·科威尔在结果公布前告诉SBS，比利时和埃及看起来是澳大利亚最危险的对手。 “一旦你通过了小组赛阶段，他们也成功地通过了，现在就是一切了。 “这是你必须踢出最好足球的地方。这是当你的机会很低时你必须出击的地方，你必须能够保持冷静，希望我们能够做到这一点并更进一步。” 澳大利亚队面临的挑战是在几名球员缺阵的情况下踢出最好的足球。 在雅各布·意大利（Jacob Italiano）和马修·莱基（Mathew Leckie）受伤分别离开训练营前往奥地利和墨尔本后，澳大利亚队的阵容只剩下 24 名球员。 意大利人在对阵土耳其队和美国队的比赛中在训练中受伤，而莱基则在球队0-2输给美国队的比赛中腿筋受伤。 澳大利亚此前曾与埃及交手过两次，并于 1987 年在总统杯点球大战中获胜。2010 年，他们在开罗的一场友谊赛中以 3-0 落败。 该...

reflection.en: The intense drama of a knockout stage, decided in the final moments, reminds us of the focused effort required to achieve a goal. Just as athletes run to win a prize, Yahweh calls us to live with purpose and discipline in our own race of faith.
reflection.zh: 淘汰赛阶段的激烈戏剧性，在最后时刻才尘埃落定，这提醒我们实现目标需要专注的努力。正如运动员奔跑以赢得奖赏，雅伟也呼召我们在信心的赛程中带着目标和纪律生活。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The controversy surrounding Dettol's advertisement highlights the importance of recognizing the inherent dignity of every individual. When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

title.zh: 充电加速：电动汽车增长超预期

summary.en: China is driving the electric vehicle transition but Europe and other countries are catching up fast. EVs are getting cheaper, more efficient and can travel farther than ever.

body.zh: 中国正在推动电动汽车转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。电动汽车变得越来越便宜、效率越来越高，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

summary.en: Six children's programs had a $54 million backing from resource companies, with hundreds more deals, prompting calls for scrutiny.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Across 31 lifesaving clubs in Western Australia, thousands of children learn beach safety and surf skills in their iconic singlets and caps. Since 2019, those uniforms have been emblazoned with the name of the country's largest independent oil and gas company: Woodside.

This sponsorship, worth approximately $5 million, is just one of around 260 programs designed for Australian children sponsored by fossil fuel companies, according to a new report.

The report, published on Monday by climate communication charity, Comms Declare, found fossil fuel money was behind a broad range of programs aimed at children in schools, museums, and sporting clubs across the country.

"This report lays bare just how much effort is going into [fossil fuel companies'] buying a social licence," independent senator David Pocock told the media on Monday.

"[It lays bare] how much effort is going into shaping what young Australians think and understand about fossil fuel companies' contribution to a changing climate."

Woodside pointed SBS News to its 2025 Social Contribution Report, which said its social investments raised awareness and understanding of the environment; supported early childhood development and education; and created resilient and sustainable communities.

Pocock, along with senators Penny Allman-Payne and Steph Hodgins-May, have called on the government to launch a Senate inquiry into the influence of fossil fuel companies over children's public life.

The report named Santos as the biggest sponsor of children's programs with 71 programs, as well as BHP, Woodside, Glencore, Chevron, and Shell.

While Western Australia had the highest concentration of sponsorships, with 120 programs, researchers found the programs clustered in remote areas where the mining industry had a stronger presence.

In some instances, oil and gas companies were sponsoring the production of climate education materials in ways that minimised the role of burning fossil fuels as the main driver of global warming .

Last year, the Queensland Museum retired materials from Shell's sponsored "Future Makers" learning program, after Comms Declare found its explanation of carbon dioxide absorption in the oceans failed to mention where excess carbon dioxide comes from .

Another activity asked students to design technological responses to carbon reduction, such as carbon capture and storage, which critics argue shifts responsibility from reducing emissions .

The materials, designed for students in grades 7-10, had been downloaded 400,000 times, according to reporting by The Guardian.

title.en: Some households can get free electricity from Wednesday. Are you eligible?
